expect_red: a respine interrupting a respine unfolds out of a rail the frame it interrupted really drew — not out of drawn column 0, which a frame caught mid-unfold has nothing on

mutations.contract: A column a respine ADDS is drawn collapsed onto the OUTGOING FRAME'S LEFTMOST RAIL and unfolds out of it -- which is why rails carry no opacity of their own, and which has to hold from a transition frame as well as from a settled one.
mutations.note: The mutation is the pre-2026-09-15 behaviour exactly: clamp the drawn column index at 0 rather than at the outgoing frame's own leftmost index. A SETTLED outgoing frame always has a rail at drawn 0, so every guard that starts from one stays green; the witness has to interrupt a transition at e = 0.5, where the spine sits at drawn 4.5 with nothing to its left.
